abstract.p: Our team, silp_nlp, participated in the SemEval-2025 Task 2: Entity-Aware Machine Translation (EA-MT) which is focused on translating from English to the target languages. We have utilized LLM like GPT-4o in our experiment in two cases. In the first case, we have performed translation with a straightforward prompt, and in the second one, first a named entity recognition (NER) model, Universal NER, was used for extracting the named entities of a source sentence, thereafter, with the added information of the named entities, the prompt is updated for machine translation to instruct the LLM. Our results show that the addition of named entities helps the LLM to generate better translation.
